en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting an ornate multi‑storey corner building with richly decorated facades and a tall, elaborate dome-like roof tower. Awnings cover the ground-floor windows, likely of a café or hotel, and a person and a horse-drawn carriage are visible on the cobbled street in front. At the bottom margin, red printed Hungarian text identifies the location and the building.
